items.title: SpaceX stock below $100 is a buying opportunity: Panel on end of lockup period
items.summary: SpaceX (SPCX) stock continues to near $100 per share on Thursday as the space venture's lockup period expires, allowing employees and early investors to sell their stock. Slatestone Wealth chief market strategist Kenny Polcari and AllSource Investment Management founder Patrick Kennedy share their outlook on SpaceX stock value, especially as over 900 million shares get unlocked.

items.title: Serve Robotics Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Serve Robotics (NASDAQ:SERV) reported second-quarter revenue growth but sharply reduced its full-year outlook after delivery volume through Uber declined for the first time in 17 quarters, prompting the company to reassess the future of the partnership and redirect resources toward other channels.

items.title: This Insurance Company Partners With Uber. Its Stock Hit A Buy Zone.
items.summary: Property and casualty insurance company Skyward Specialty Insurance Group is sustaining its place on the stringent IBD Sector Leaders list.  The specialty insurance company topped second-quarter earnings estimates on Aug. 4.  Skyward finalized its acquisition of Apollo Group Holdings on Jan. 2.
